594 if _cyb___py_driver_init: return 0

597 if handle == NULL: 

598 raise RuntimeError('Failed to open cuda') 

599 # Get latest cuGetProcAddress_v2

604 ptds_mode = CU_GET_PROC_ADDRESS_PER_THREAD_DEFAULT_STREAM 

605 else: 

606 ptds_mode = CU_GET_PROC_ADDRESS_DEFAULT
